title: the two-member class-descriptor registrars, one row per member
heading: ## Per-member rows: the vtable each two-member descriptor registrar installs, and its reflected type (OPUS, 2026-10-03)
lead: The family `two-member class-descriptor registrars (m_count + m_els)` (frontmatter: 38 members; {N} get a row here) shares one pattern in many spellings, stated here once and not repeated per row. Under the thread-safe static-init guard (`008092FC` / `0080929C`), each stub constructs its static class descriptor through `00632D80`, installs that descriptor's vtable, and registers members and teardowns. What differs from member to member is the static descriptor and the vtable stored into it. Each row anchors the `lea rax, [V]` whose following `mov` stores V into the static descriptor X the body also loads with a `lea` (the member's distinguishing instruction), and states V and the class V's MSVC RTTI complete-object locator names, read from the certified image. {CHECK} re-derives every row and compares it with the committed {ROWS}. Two controls are refused: a swapped value and a moved anchor. Members that do not derive are listed in [`excluded.tsv`](../../_index/candidates/opus-ee-two-member-registrars-1003/excluded.tsv).
